{{Quote|You two stay here in case they get past us. They must not escape.|Obi-Wan Kenobi orders Solok and Grohto to prevent Maul and Opress from escaping|<ref name="TSH" />}}
'''Ko Solok''' was a [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], Solok was selected to be part of a [[Unidentified task force (Plo Koon)|Jedi task force]] sent to hunt down the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] brothers [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]]. The team tracked its targets to the [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Orto Norwe]], where the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Skirmish on Orto Norwe|fought]] the duo but failed to capture them, [[Death/Legends|losing]] Master [[Grohto]] in the process. Solok then accompanied Masters [[Bruu Jun-Fan]] and [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] to the planet [[Pleem's Nexus]], where they [[Skirmish on Pleem's Nexus|engaged]] the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] again. Maul killed both Solok and Jun-Fan in the resulting [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|fight]], after which both Sith escaped.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Master Grohto, you and Master Solok supervise a search of the rest of the settlement.|Plo Koon sends Grohto and Solok to search Yellowblade's Landing|<ref name="TSH" />}}
[[File:KoSolokKenobi-TheSithHunters.png|thumb|left|300px|Ko Solok was part of a Jedi strike team sent to Orto Norwe.]]
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gran/Legends|Gran]], Ko Solok was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the final [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TSH" /> By approximately [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]&mdash;fought between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]&mdash;Solok had achieved the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. When the [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] resurfaced during the conflict, Solok was selected by Master [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] to be part of a [[Unidentified task force (Plo Koon)|Jedi task force]] to hunt down Maul and his [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] brother, [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]]. Aside from Koon and Solok, the group included Masters [[Grohto]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and [[Bruu Jun-Fan]], as well as the latter's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Tatsu]], and a group of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] led by [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Mojo]].<ref name="TSH" />

The team first took a [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)/Legends|''Consular''-class cruiser]] to<ref name="TSH" /> the [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="FF23">{{FactFile2014|23|PLO 1-6|Plo Koon}}</ref> [[Orto Norwe]]<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC discussion 2023.jpg|creator=Jason Fry|date=2023-03-25}}</ref> based on data from several [[Information broker/Legends|informants]] in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]], who claimed the Sith were there. Solok and the others traveled to the planetary surface in a [[T-6 shuttle/Legends|T-6 shuttle]], and once there, they found the aftermath of the Sith's visit: the brothers' abandoned [[Unidentified Turtle Tanker/Legends|Turtle Tanker]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] and a [[Unidentified cantina (Yellowblade's Landing)|cantina]] full of [[Death/Legends|corpses]]. The bodies belonged to members of the [[The Scourge|Scourge]] criminal organization, and after sighting them, Koon ordered Solok and Grohto to organize a search of the surrounding the settlement [[Yellowblade's Landing]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] made their way to a [[Cave/Legends|cave]] that housed the local [[Unidentified Scourge base|Scourge base]], where they suspected Maul was hiding based on Jun-Fan's [[Psychometry/Legends|psychometric]] analysis of a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] from the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] [[Massacre in Yellowblade's Landing|massacre]].<ref name="TSH" />

[[File:Death_of_Ko_Solok.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Darth Maul kills Ko Solok.]]
Once at the base, Kenobi ordered Solok, Grohto, and Tatsu to remain in a chamber near the entrance to prevent the Sith brothers from escaping. The trio waited there while Kenobi and the others headed deeper into the base, where they located Maul and Opress but were attacked by [[Wampa/Legends|wampas]] that the Sith had released from cages within the base. Maul, having evaded the other Jedi while they were distracted by the wampas, [[Skirmish on Orto Norwe|attacked]] Solok and their two companions. The Zabrak entered the chamber by leaping through a [[Window/Legends|window]] and kicking Solok, after which he [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|killed]] Grohto and injured Tatsu and Kenobi. Incapacitating the Jedi allowed the Sith brothers to escape aboard one of the Scourge's [[Starship/Legends|ships]] with a [[Esano's sister|hostage]], whom they had found [[Prison/Legends|incarcerated]] in the base. Koon and Jun-Fan analyzed a piece of jewelry that the brothers' hostage had dropped and discovered that the Sith's destination was the planet [[Pleem's Nexus]], where the hostage lived.<ref name="TSH" />

Leaving their injured behind, Solok, Jun-Fan, and Koon flew to Pleem's Nexus. There they found Maul and Opress trying to load their vessel with a large haul of [[Gold/Legends|gold]]&mdash;which, unbeknownst to the Jedi, the brothers hoped to use to fund a criminal empire. The Jedi immediately [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|engaged]] Maul and Opress in [[Skirmish on Pleem's Nexus|combat]], and during the ensuing fight, Solok was killed when Maul threw his [[Darth Maul's double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] through the Jedi's chest. Jun-Fan and several clone [[Troop/Legends|troopers]] also perished, while Koon was incapacitated, allowing Maul and Opress to escape from the planet.<ref name="TSH" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|No! Ko Solok!|Bruu Jun-Fan cries out as Solok is killed|<ref name="TSH" />}}
Solok had [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and pink skin. The Jedi was skilled enough to reach the rank of Jedi Master, but was outmatched in combat on two occasions by the Sith [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Maul and died in the second case.<ref name="TSH" />

==Equipment==
Solok used a green-bladed lightsaber in combat. The Gran wore green cold-weather gear on Orto Norwe and green [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]] on Pleem's Nexus.<ref name="TSH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ko Solok first appeared in ''[[The Clone Wars: The Sith Hunters]]'', a [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] that was written by [[Henry Gilroy]] and [[Steven Melching]], illustrated by [[Vicenç Villagrasa]],<ref name="TSH" /> and released on [[August 15]], [[2012]].<ref name="DH-Link">{{DarkHorse|url=Books/19-780/Star-Wars-The-Clone-Wars-The-Sith-Hunters-TPB|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Sith Hunters TPB}}</ref>
